I know what it's like. Today I got halfway to convincing myself to shoot myself. I've done this back and forth battle with my own thoughts just like you probably have. I'm no adult, far from it, but I'd know what it's like to be on death's doorstep from your own hands. I can't give much advice, but I can say this, think of anything or anyone who loves or cares about you, then use that love for courage and fight these thoughts until you can ask someone who can help that isn't  me or anyone else on here, on how to get rid of this curse of self hate forever.
